youtube_title: My Dad Refuses To Pay Anything But Full Price | Funny Cartoon
description:
Two days before Black Friday, Tasha has coupons, alarms and a spreadsheet. Her dad Doug has paid full price for everything, tipped the self checkout and called the cable company to raise his bill. His wallet would like a word. So would his secret in the closet.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #blackfriday
tiktok_caption: my dad only pays full price 💸 his wallet has notes #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #blackfriday

lines.text: Okay. Black Friday plan. Coupons, alarms, snacks. We leave at four in the morning.
I will not be joining you. I paid full price.
For what?
Everything. I walked in, I saw the price, I paid it. Like a man.
Hello. I am his wallet. I would like to file a complaint.
Dad, the sale is in two days. Two.
Deals are for people who do not believe in themselves.
Deals are for people who like money.
Let us start with the turkey.
Oh no. The turkey.
The sign said buy one, get one free.
So you got two turkeys.
I paid for one and left the free one. It deserves a family that earned it.
It is a frozen turkey. It does not want a family.
He also tipped the self checkout.
You tipped a machine?
It said thank you for shopping. Nobody says that to me.
Okay. What else.
Today I bought the big television. Tonight. Full price.
It is half off on Friday. I have it in a spreadsheet. With a color.
I do not wait in lines. Lines wait for me.
The line was empty. He waited anyway. To feel something.
The cashier asked if I had a rewards card. I said, I am the reward.
That is not a sentence.
He also said keep the change. It was a card.
Dad, I have saved forty one dollars this month with coupons.
And how much did you spend on gas driving to the coupons?
That is private information.
Sixty. She drove to three states for paper towels.
Two states. One was a very big gas station.
Then this morning I called the cable company.
To lower the bill?
To raise it. The lady was so nice. I wanted her to win.
She put him on hold to cry a little.
Who negotiates up?
A man with nothing to prove. And very nice phone manners.
I used to be thick. I used to be a leather brick.
Now I am a leather envelope. You can see through me.
Okay. I am still going at four. They have the headphones I want for sixty percent off.
I have been watching that price since July. Every morning. With coffee.
Mm hm.
Tell her. Please. I cannot keep this in. I am thin.
Tell me what?
Look in the closet. Behind the vacuum.
Those are my headphones. The good ones. The ones from the spreadsheet.
Full price. Bought them in July.
Why would you pay full price for a thing I was going to get on sale?
Because every year you stand in a parking lot at four in the morning in the cold.
And this year I wanted you to sleep in. On Thanksgiving weekend. Like a person.
He has been planning this since July. I have been crying since July.
Dad. That is the sweetest thing anyone has ever overpaid for.
I would pay full price for you every time.
Okay. I love you. I am still getting up at four.
Why?
To return them and buy them again on sale. That is twenty three dollars.
You would price match a gift?
I would price match a birthday.
Finally. Someone in this family is on my side.
Fine. But I am driving. And I am paying for parking. Full price.
I need to lie down. In a pocket. Forever.
